scope: Separates active cast-gauge timing, local command cast-time data, cast-ready battle-result VFX selection, and SubStat Chant state. It does not infer live server behavior, packet-to-action causality, or a shared cast/chant type enum.

wireCarrier.name: SetActorPropertyPacket
wireCarrier.framing: 168-byte subpacket = 16-byte outer subevent framing + 152-byte game message; the game message is a 16-byte prefix plus the 136-byte application payload.
wireCarrier.shape: payload +0 is a running-byte total; payload +1..+135 is a typed variable property stream. Property hashes are record identities, not fixed packet offsets.

activeCastGauge.firstNativeBoundary: FUN_00775180 resolves a property registry entry, then calls the function pointer at propertyEntry+4. The retained native evidence does not identify fixed CharaBase or PlayerBase offsets for these four property names.

properties.name: playerWork.castCommandClient
properties.consumer: PlayerBaseClass.getCastCommand; ActionMenuWidget.updateCastInfo uses the nonzero value to locate a custom command and start ActionGaugeWidget.

properties.name: charaWork.battleTemp.castGauge_speed[0]
properties.consumer: CharaBaseClass.getCastSpeed(index); no direct ActionGaugeWidget read was found in the retained decoded script route.

properties.name: charaWork.battleTemp.castGauge_speed[1]
properties.consumer: CharaBaseClass.getCastSpeed(index); no direct ActionGaugeWidget read was found in the retained decoded script route.

uiDuration.formula: remaining = player.getCastEndTime() - worldMaster._getServerTime(); if remaining <= 0 then remaining = 1; progressRate = 1 / remaining
uiDuration.conclusion: The active gauge duration comes from the property-stream deadline relative to client server-time state, not directly from gameCommandBasic cast_time.

captureCrossCheck.staticLookup: client-data row 27346 is Cure; staticactor row 27346 is /Command/Game/Magic/CureMagic
captureCrossCheck.boundary: This is an exact same-integer lookup, not proof that a particular 0x012D command or 0x0139..0x013C result in the capture was Cure.

localCommandCastTime.getterBehavior: Reads column 76, then may replace it with a nonzero getForceCastTimeForCaster override or multiply it by a nonzero returned modifier.
localCommandCastTime.boundary: Column 76 is local command metadata used before or around command execution. It is not the active cast-gauge deadline and no sheet column was proven to select a chant or cast presentation type.

castReadyVfx.boundary: This is a native cast-ready VFX selector, not a command-sheet cast type or active gauge duration. The exact selector-to-Rapture clip class remains behind the final indirect call.

chantStatusBoundary.bits: 8..15; kind 1 reads bits 12..15 and kind 2 reads bits 8..11
chantStatusBoundary.modePacketFence: The s2c 0x0144 payload has a historical byte +1 chantId label, but its retained apply route writes only CharaSubStatStorage+0x18 ModeBorder and fires _onChangeSubStatMode. It does not establish an action cast-type field.
chantStatusBoundary.durationFence: Status display durations use separate charaWork.statusShownTime property-stream fields; no C++ countdown or command-sheet duration join is proven here.
chantStatusBoundary.conclusion: SubStat Chant is status-state metadata and must not be merged with the action cast gauge, gameCommandBasic cast_time, or the battle-result CastOrReadyPreAction selector.

package2Boundary: The c2s 0x012D EventStart path carries generic eventName and Lua parameter data. It does not expose a stable scalar gameCommand id or the active cast-gauge deadline.
unresolved: The time unit and epoch used by castEndClient and worldMaster._getServerTime.
The property-entry function that maps each 0x0137 hash to a concrete native storage offset.
The semantics of the getForceCastTimeForCaster override and multiplier values.
A universal packet-level castCommandClient-to-command causality join beyond the one captured same-integer cross-check.
The final selector-to-Rapture clip class behind FUN_00812B50's indirect call.
The concrete enum identities behind the two SubStat Chant nibbles.
rejectedImports: Do not treat gameCommandBasic column 76 as the active cast-gauge deadline or assign it a time unit.
Do not use gameCommandBasic column 36 as a cast type or as a staticactor class-path key.
Do not treat effect category 0x6f or visual selector 8 as a command-sheet column.
Do not infer a stable command id from c2s 0x012D payload +0x08 or from its opaque eventName/Lua blob.
Do not treat s2c 0x0144's historical chantId label as action-cast presentation state.
Do not claim RaptureCastResultClip or RaptureChantSyncClip is the active cast-bar consumer.
